entries.heading: EXTENSION OF EXCEPTIONS PROCESS FOR MEDICARE THERAPY CAPS
ancestors: TITLE III—IMPROVING THE QUALITY AND EFFICIENCY OF HEALTH CARE
Subtitle B—Improving Medicare for Patients and Providers
entries.text:
SEC. 3103. EXTENSION OF EXCEPTIONS PROCESS FOR MEDICARE THERAPY CAPS.

    Section 1833(g)(5) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 
1395l(g)(5)) is amended by striking ``December 31, 2009'' and inserting 
``December 31, 2010''.
